A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 23-page paper, including Appendices A–D. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–D report original policy-training and evaluation results on Mountain Car, Pendulum, and simulated and physical Quanser Aero 2 systems.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and their outcomes, including the numerical results in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: The analytical control policy, Chebyshev policy parameterization, and training procedures are unchanged. The correction in the appendix does not alter any algorithm or model component.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate MountainCarContinuous-v0, Pendulum-v1, and Quanser Aero 2 in simulation and on physical hardware. The additional Mountain Car scenarios in Appendix A also match.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including the RL Baselines3 Zoo agents and the MLP comparisons reported in the main text and appendices.

E3.justification: Evaluation settings match, including 100 evenly spaced Mountain Car starting positions, the 50×50 Pendulum initialization grid, and the Aero 2 target-pitch evaluations. Training budgets, model configurations, and metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the same discrete-control checks, optimizer and MLP-architecture comparisons, policy-trajectory analyses, polynomial-degree study, and sim-to-real analyses in Appendices A, C, and D.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting are identical, including the 20-agent experiments in Appendix C and mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting over 10 Aero 2 episodes in Tables 8–9.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match. For example, Table 1 retains mean returns of 98.10 for CH-3-PPO and 93.91 for PPO; the appendix result entries are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix A.1.2 corrects the Cauchy–Schwarz equality explanation: the cosine between positively proportional f and g changes from 'zero' to 'one'. This fixes a mathematical statement; Lemma 2.3, its minimizer, and the remaining derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about Mountain Car optimality and universal, compact Chebyshev policies, including the claimed 4.18-fold regret reduction and 277-fold parameter reduction.

C2.justification: Interpretations of policy behavior and sim-to-real performance are unchanged. The same limitations concerning dimensionality, numerical stability, and allocating model capacity to particular state-space regions remain.

D1.justification: Reported software versions, initialization details, hyperparameters, hardware, runtimes, and code-access information are identical. The updated arXiv version link introduces no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 1.2 and the bibliography contain the same cited works and research positioning. No novelty claim or relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: Editing is limited to the single-word correction in Appendix A.1.2 and the updated arXiv version/date stamp. Section organization and the remaining prose are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–14 and Tables 1–9 retain their designs, labels, captions, and placement. The proof correction produces only incidental word respacing, with no structural layout revision.

improvement.justification: Changing the cosine from zero to one in Appendix A.1.2 removes a false statement and makes the proof explanation consistent with its positive-proportionality condition. This is a limited improvement in mathematical accuracy; the lemma’s conclusion, methods, empirical evidence, and limitations remain unchanged.
